The court will most likely uphold the statute as constitutional. The 20% prior-vote threshold is an objective line tied to demonstrated support, and the 180-day circulation window matches the deadline parties face for their primaries, so the scheme treats party and non-party candidates comparably. The 7% petition requirement is the most vulnerable element, but it is in the range courts have accepted (*Jenness v. Fortson* upheld 5%), so it is unlikely to be struck down alone.

CONFIDENCE: 62
